newsitem.title: CHINA: China customs says 1996 trade surplus $12.24 bln.
newsitem.headline: China customs says 1996 trade surplus $12.24 bln.

text.p: China's trade surplus was $12.24 billion in 1996, the Xinhua news agency on Friday quoted customs administration figures as showing.
The State Statistical Bureau said last month the surplus was provisionally estimated at about $16 billion.
It gave no explanation for the disparity between the two sets of statistics.
China's trade surplus for last year was down from the $16.7 billion trade surplus recorded in 1995.
Exports last year totalled $151.07 billion, up 1.5 percent from 1995, Xinhua quoted the customs figures as showing.
Imports were $138.83 billion, up 5.1 percent, the official news agency said.
Exports had picked up in the second half of last year after sliding in the first six months, it said.
Growth in imports had slowed after the elimination of some tax exemptions and other preferential policies, it said.
